home.heroSubtitle: Step into a world of compassionate care and gentle clarity tailored to university life. Put down the heavy backpack — without guilt, pressure, or streaks.
home.heroConfidence: No sign-up required to try · 100% private
home.chatUser: "I've been feeling constantly overwhelmed with deadlines and lost interest in studying..."
home.chatPax1: I hear you. You don't have to carry the whole semester at once. Let's unpack just one small pebble together today.
home.chatPax2: "Thank you Pax, already feeling a bit of room to breathe."
home.chatMicro: Always here for you. Take a gentle breath. ✨
home.narrativeTitle2: one quiet moment at a time.
home.ch1Desc: Pour out raw, messy worries without worrying about spelling, bullet points, or structure. Pax catches the emotional spillover and untangles the knot for you without judgement.
home.ch1Cta: Instant cognitive relief • No formatting needed
home.ch1Demo1: "Neuroscience lab report due Thursday, Haven't started section 3, my roommate hasn't done the dishes in 4 days and I feel so guilty about staying in bed this morning..."
home.ch1DemoResult: Pax categorized into: 1 Urgent • 1 Personal • 1 Let Go
home.chChatDesc: Unlike the one-way release of Mind Dump, Pax Chat is a warm, two-way dialogue. Ready whenever you need via the floating button, Pax offers a caring ear, gentle perspective, and non-judgmental comfort whenever you feel overwhelmed.
home.chChatUserBubble: "My mind is completely full, I honestly don't feel like I can handle anything today..."
home.chChatPaxBubble: "That's completely okay. You don't have to jump straight into productivity. Want to share what feels heaviest on your chest right now?"
home.ch2Desc: When everything feels like an emergency, nothing gets started. Pax isolates a single 10-minute micro-action so small it feels effortless to begin.
home.ch2Cta: Bypasses ADHD paralysis • Zero toxic streaks
home.ch2Step1: Open Lab Report & Write Title + Headings
home.ch3Desc: When study overwhelm peaks, step into sensory micro-tools: popping bubble wraps, 60-second synchronized box breathing, or listening to quiet rainy library ambient soundscapes.
home.sandboxTitle: Drop one heavy thought right here.
home.sandboxDesc: Type whatever is sitting in the back of your mind right now. We will never save it without your permission.
home.sandboxPlaceholder: e.g. My group project partner isn't answering and the pitch deck is due at midnight...
home.sandboxSample: Need to study for chem midterms, finish group deck, and get more sleep...
home.sandboxEmptyWarning: Please write what's on your mind first
home.paxFeedbackBody: "Take a gentle breath. You can't control their response time, but you can control your own peace. Your only 10-minute micro-step: write a short outline for slide 1 and take a 5-minute warm water break."
home.closingTitle: Ready to put down what you've been carrying?
home.closingDesc: Take five quiet minutes right now. Unpack the backpack and breathe freely.
home.footerTag: Always calm • Never algorithmic • Made with care for students
unpack.mainHeading: What's taking up space in your mind right now?
